title: Sonder.gg — role play as anyone, anywhere, anytime
author: worldcv

comments.author: multiversecitizen
comments.body: This is a really cool concept and execution, well done! Which ai agent is running as I play the game? Also does the game respect real events of that specific place/time? Or is it always fiction?

replies.author: worldcv
replies.body:
Thanks! It’s using gemini flash 3 — was using claude for a while but it took too long to load in 

The game tries to respect realistic events but it’s largely dramatized fiction

Had a previous version where it was solely rooted in non-fiction but then the choose your own adventure element couldn’t land cause it would deviate from reality and become fiction anyway

comments.author: monsterfurby
comments.body: I was almost prepared to go "Eurgh, another chatbot" but this is actually a really cool idea and execution. Small pointer: your Google SSO seems to be broken.

replies.author: worldcv
replies.body:
Oh real lives is interesting I need to check it out. Would love to hear more about WILL too — how do they pull off that kinda multiversal game? 

And good call on the Google SSO! Just pushed out a fix

comments.body: This is really, really neat.  Poetic too
